policy.downstreamRule: Only PASS may unlock Portfolio Fit and later decision gates. FAIL blocks the pipeline. OPEN_REVIEW keeps all downstream investment gates locked.
policy.evidenceRule: A status requires explicit source evidence tied to the canonical instrument identity. Discovery ticker/name, portfolio presence, sector metadata and general company evidence never imply Halal compliance.
policy.conflictRule: No provider conflict may be auto-resolved. Conflicting explicit verdicts produce OPEN_REVIEW until manually adjudicated.
policy.coverageRule: Absence of an instrument-specific verdict is not evidence. Methodology pages, search snippets for other instruments, names, tickers, index labels and marketing descriptions cannot produce PASS or FAIL.
policy.freshnessRule: Store provider review/check date when available. Re-screen periodically; stale evidence must not silently remain decisive.
policy.fundRule: For funds/ETFs, an exact-ISIN issuer source that explicitly states Shariah-compliant investment principles may produce PASS when identity is unambiguous and no current conflicting approved evidence is known. External screeners remain corroborative and periodic re-check is required.

IE00B27YCN58.reason: Die exakte Anteilsklasse IE00B27YCN58 wird von iShares/BlackRock als iShares MSCI World Islamic UCITS ETF geführt. Der Emittent beschreibt das Anlageziel ausdrücklich als Nachbildung eines Index aus Unternehmen, die Scharia-Anlageprinzipien erfüllen, und bezeichnet den Fonds als Shari'ah-Fonds. Musaffa nennt ISWD zusätzlich als islamische MSCI-World-Alternative. Es wurde in dieser Prüfung kein aktueller gegenteiliger Befund verifiziert.

evidence.note: Exact ISIN IE00B27YCN58; benchmark MSCI Developed World Islamic Index; issuer describes Shariah-fund restrictions.
Fund objective: track an index of developed-market companies complying with Shariah investment principles.
Names ISWD as an Islamic MSCI World alternative and describes the MSCI World Islamic Index as Shariah-screened.
No conflicting verdict used; ETF screening coverage is limited.
